description: This file contains functions for displaying survey question responses within the SugarCRM framework. It includes logic for retrieving linked beans, formatting responses based on question type, and rendering HTML via Smarty templates.

methods.name: question_responses_display
methods.description: Generates HTML to display survey question responses based on view type, retrieving linked responses and questions, sorting them, and rendering with Smarty.

methods.name: convertQuestionResponseForDisplay
methods.description: Converts a response array into formatted output based on question type, such as checkboxes, radio buttons, matrix, date/time, rating, scale, or text.
